registered_predictions.P1: both multiplicative heads beat the 0.25 single-property ceiling on the conjunctive task; accuracy near 1.
registered_predictions.P2: each factor QK form concentrates on ONE planted property block, one factor per property, up to swapping the two factors.
registered_predictions.P3: ablating either factor drops accuracy to about the single-property ceiling.
registered_predictions.P4: the B1 census reports (c) genuine conjunction for multiplicative heads on the conjunctive task, and (a) collapse or (b) alignment on the control tasks.
registered_predictions.P5: the standard single-circuit head at matched capacity does measurably worse on the conjunctive task than the multiplicative heads.
registered_predictions.P6: changing the query type moves attention onto the key carrying the new type.
